title: Latency budgets
description: The wall-clock ceiling each timed seam must be observed to meet. Discharged by the latency-budget checker in verification support and attested by one scenario rather than one per seam.
rationale: Every one of these was a constant chosen without measurement, and one was wrong by a factor of eight: the tagline ceiling stood at five seconds against a call that returned nothing inside forty, so the tagline never filled and the help rendered without it as though that were the design. A ceiling nobody measures is a guess that fails silently, because the seam it bounds degrades rather than erroring. Declaring them in one list means a new timed seam adds a line here rather than a scenario, and the attestation stays one scenario however many seams there are.
